page.overview:
What is Universal Pictures?

Universal Pictures is the film studio that produces and distributes the Jurassic Park films, as well as other popular films such as [https://fastandfurious.fandom.com/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious_(film) Fast and Furious], Wicked, Back to the Future, [https://jaws.fandom.com/wiki/Jaws Jaws] and The Mummy. It is owned by Comcast Corporation and its highest grossing film to date is Jurassic World.

Its production studios are located in California and its distribution and other corporate offices are based in New York.

Category:Out of universe businesses Category:Locations Category:Businesses Category:Brands

Also known as: Universal, Universal Studios.
